summary: Input validation constrains dimensions/iterations and nItems is derived from the CLI dimensions/sparsity. CSR construction and device copies cover the whole matrix and vector. Average-row-length dispatch selects one of widths 2/4/8/16/32; the selected kernel assigns contiguous subgroups to rows, bounds rows by numRows, walks each CSR interval in Width strides, reduces and writes lane-0 output. A warmup is synchronized before events. Compiled event-timed main's iteration backedge encloses the dispatch branches and reaches the matching stub; all five compiled variants are retained in final sm86 SASS.
